title: The ENTIRE History of Israel in 10 Minutes
description:
The history of Israel: a narrow land bridge between three continents, and every empire that wanted it. This Israel history documentary covers the ancient Israelites, the Roman exile, the birth of Zionism, and the modern Arab-Israeli conflicts.

​Israel holds a tiny fraction of one percent of the world's land but some of its most fiercely contested sacred earth, and today it is one of the most technologically advanced—and heavily scrutinized—countries on Earth. Some of the oldest securely dated human traces outside of Africa, 1.5 million years old, were found here.

​This documentary follows the complete history of Israel: the ancient walls of Jericho, the Canaanite city-states, the Kingdoms of Israel and Judah, the First Temple, the Babylonian Exile, the Dead Sea Scrolls, the Maccabean Revolt, Herod the Great, the Jewish-Roman Wars and the siege of Masada, the Byzantine era, the Islamic conquest and the Dome of the Rock, the Crusaders and Saladin, the long Ottoman centuries, Theodor Herzl and political Zionism, the British Mandate and the Balfour Declaration, the tragedy of the Holocaust, the 1948 Declaration of Independence, the Six-Day War, the Yom Kippur War, the Camp David Accords, the Intifadas, the Iron Dome, and the wars leading into 2026.

​The Babylonians could not erase its identity. The Romans could not scatter its memory out of existence. The empires of the Middle Ages could not hold it forever. And in 2026, Israel's oldest story is happening again: the fight over a very small, very sacred piece of earth.

​This Israel documentary is based on archaeological discoveries, peer-reviewed research, and primary historical sources.

We bring world history to life while remaining faithful to the historical record.
